Iterable<EpistemicEdge>, RandomAccess
public class EpistemicEdgeList extends EdgeList<EpistemicEdge>
The list of epistemic edges in a story graph, which represent each character's beliefs about the current state of a story.
Author:
Stephen G. Ware

    • add

      public EpistemicEdge add(Node actual, Character character, Node beliefs)
      Creates a new epistemic edge that extends from a tail node to a head node and is labeled with an character.

      If an epistemic edge already exists from the tail node for this character and a different head node is given, this method throws an exception. If the same head node is given, the existing edge is returned.

      This method updates the story graph's meta-data last modified timestamp.

      Parameters:
      actual - the tail node, representing the state the story is actually in
      character - the character that has beliefs
      beliefs - the head node, representing the story state the character beliefs to be the case
      Returns:
      a new epistemic edge with the given tail, label, and head, or the existing edge if that exact edge already exists
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if an edge already exists from the tail node for this character but not to the given head node
      IllegalArgumentException - if the tail node, character, or head node have been removed or were not created in this list's story graph
